messages:
maria: Heads-up — we need a short sync on the embeddings endpoint behavior. Customer asks keep hitting edge cases around batching + backpressure.
aj: quick Q — are we still leaning to a hard batch_size cap + async queue or prefer immediate 429s under pressure?
sam: my vote: bounded queue with backpressure hint header. give customers a retry-after and a queue-position when possible.
kevin: +1 on hint header. but we need clear SLOs: what % of requests can we queue vs reject for Dedicated vs Hosted?
natalie: customers care about latency more than guaranteed acceptance. most want deterministic 95th percentile, not an infinite queue.
maria: proposal: two knobs — "max_sync_batch" (per-request immediate batching size) and "queue_mode" (off|bounded|async). defaults: max_sync_batch=128, queue_mode=bounded(size=1000, timeout=5s)
aj: what about dimensions? some customers need 4096, others 1536. supporting multiple dims forces model-binding rules and storage differences.
kevin: model binding idea: bind endpoint -> model variant with dim metadata. so the endpoint advertises dims it supports. if caller requests incompatible dim -> 400.
sam: also consider on-the-fly down-projecting (4096->1536) costs and quality loss. maybe we offer an opt-in transformer for customers who accept reduced fidelity.
kevin: can we avoid per-request negotiation? i suggest: endpoints are created with "dim: 1536" or "dim: 4096". default is 1536. migration path: dedicated customers can request multi-dim endpoints but will pay delta.
maria: response format: customers asked for per-item vector + original id. example:
```
[ {"id": "req-1", "embedding": [0.001, ...], "model": "rwk-embed-1.0"}, {"id": "req-2", "error": "timeout"} ]
```
include top-level metadata: model, batch_size, queue_mode, processing_time_ms.
natalie: rollout criteria: clear docs, test harness for per-tenant load, and a canary that enforces queue_mode=off (to validate upstream retry logic).
aj: ops concerns: instrument queue depth, queue_wait_ms histogram, dropped_count, and a backpressure incident runbook.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary/embeddings-v2 2026-05-14T18:00Z
maria: action items: aj to draft SLA table for Hosted vs Dedicated (due EOD Tue). kevin to write endpoint creation API (dim + queue_mode fields). sam to prototype queue hint header and error codes. natalie to draft customer comms for dim migration.
aj: noted, will ping infra for capacity sims.
kevin: will sketch API here:
```
POST /v1/embeddings/endpoints
{
  "name": "emb-1536-std",
  "model": "rwinf-embed-1536",
  "dim": 1536,
  "queue_mode": {"type":"bounded","size":1000,"timeout_ms":5000},
  "max_sync_batch": 128
}
```
maria: cool. one more — let's add a response header `X-Queue-Position` when queued and `Retry-After` when timed out. keeps clients simple.
aj: agree. thanks all — will consolidate notes into a spec PR.
